scope: Proposition 3.2 (Uniform cylinder and partition rates) of the manuscript “Exact mass asymptotics for the two-dimensional O(4) lattice model” (preprints/Exact-mass-asymptotics-for-the-two-dimensional-O4-lattice-model-October-5-2026/exact-mass-o4.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 215 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4eb3ab28f7565322), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 13. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For all admitted trajectories of Proposition 3.1 with N ≥ N0 and terminal coupling h ∈ IH, there are constants CH, wH < ∞, independent of the trajectory, such that every dyadic w ≥ wH satisfies E(w) − m(β) a ≤ CHw−1/4 (3.4) and − log ∆(w) w − m(β) a ≤ CHw−1/4 . (3.5)
